title: Vintage DeJur Critic Model 40 Handheld Exposure Meter With Case And Charts
categoryName: Cameras & Photo:Vintage Movie & Photography:Vintage Parts & Accessories
descriptionText: The Vintage DeJur Critic Model 40 Handheld Exposure Meter is a classic piece of equipment for photographers looking to achieve perfect exposure levels in their images. Made in the United States by DeJur, this light/exposure meter is compatible with a variety of brands and features a handy case for easy storage and transport. The meter includes charts to help photographers accurately calibrate their camera settings for optimal results. Perfect for vintage filmmakers and photographers alike, this DeJur Critic Model 40 is a reliable tool for achieving professional-quality exposure levels.
